title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E11 — Dilemma
Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E12 — Hangup
Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E13 — Crash
Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E1 — Problem
DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E4 — Bad Time on the Border
A lost Mexican girl leads B.A. to a smuggling ring responsible for illegally transporting aliens across the border.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E5 — When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
An Indian boy wants to stop a wealthy rancher (Morgan Woodward) rustling mustangs on an Arizona reservation.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E6 — When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
The team attacks a trainload of mustangs headed for Mexico, only to have Hannibal and B.A. taken prisoner.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E7 — The Taxicab Wars
Hannibal poses as a rich Texan and his cohorts work as cabbies to save a struggling company from a ruthless competitor (Michael Ironside).

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E8 — Labor Pains
The team defends striking farmworkers from a corrupt grower paying starvation wages; guest Penny Peyser.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E9 — There's Always a Catch
An extortionist threatens a fisherman's livelihood. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E10 — Water, Water Everywhere
A greedy developer attempts to stop disabled veterans (Jim Knaub, Jon L. Feather, R. David Smith) from renovating a desert town.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E11 — Steel
A struggling contractor's (Norman Alden) warehouse-demolition site is sabotaged by a mob-hired competitor.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E12 — The White Ballot
Face becomes a candidate for sheriff to expose a small-town law officer's shady dealings. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.
